notes.title: THERE'S SOMETHING WRONG WITH... Play Demo on Next Fest
notes.notes:
The [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] is HERE!!! And for the first time, we are part of it.🎉

 
[b]“There’s Something Wrong With…”[/b] is our newest video game project, and its demo awaits you on Steam. Safety first, though. Before we go any further, please answer these questions:

➡ Are you afraid of spooky and creepy stories❓

➡ Are you afraid of being in confined spaces❓

➡ Are you afraid of monsters breathing down your neck❓

If you answered "no" three times, then you fear nothing, which means you can face the mysterious tunnels and whatever is lurking in its darkest, thickest, blackest corners…


[h1]YOU ARE READY![/h1]

 
👉[b]Try the Demo:[/b] Experience "There’s Something Wrong With…" firsthand by playing our demo during Steam Next Fest. We're looking forward to hearing your thoughts, so please feel free to leave us your honest feedback. Your input is simply invaluable in helping us make the game even better!

📝[b]Add to Your Wishlist:[/b] If you enjoy the demo, maybe consider adding "There’s Something Wrong With…" to your Steam Wishlist ? This not only supports our development but also ensures you’ll be the first to know about all updates and the official release date.

📺[b]Watch the Trailer:[/b] Check out our trailer on our channel on YouTube and get a sneak peek at what awaits you in the game. The link to the trailer will be in the post – don’t miss it!

We can't wait for you to play the demo, and to hear your thoughts! So happy gaming and all the best from the Gamenastica Studios team!🕹️

[previewyoutube=eQX0qkckWYI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: THERE'S SOMETHING WRONG WITH... DEMO RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the launch of the demo for [b]"There’s Something Wrong with…"[/b], scheduled to release on [b]June 7th 2024[/b]. 

This new horror adventure demo will be available at the upcoming Steam [b]NEXT FEST[/b] in June.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/f7ecaa76fcb1b950e8eb37324670662aebe14c2a.png[/img]


[b]"There’s Something Wrong with…"[/b] is a first-person horror experience set in enigmatic tunnels. As players navigate through dark passages, they will discover notes, interactive objects, unusual human remains and monstrous entity. During Steam’s Next Fest, players will have the opportunity to explore these environments, experience the gameplay mechanics, and encounter formidable foe...

So, stay tuned for more updates and prepare yourself for a creepy adventure. Mark your calendars for [b]June 7th 2024[/b] and get ready to dive into the world of [b]"There’s Something Wrong with…"[/b] and during Steam’s [b]NEXT FEST[/b] this June.


[h1][b]DEMO FEATURES[/b][/h1]

        [h3][b]MYSTERIOUS TUNNELS[/b][/h3]
What could you find at the end of this tunnel? Because these tunnels are strange. Not always dark, but always concealing a secret or two. And the entity roaming through those mysterious halls... it is not just roaming... IT IS hunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/797631b29cb9bdd372422912ea827e63c4c38774.png[/img]

       [h3][b]REPLICATOR[/b][/h3]
The game does not feature a traditional inventory system. Instead, players utilize a special tool known as the Replicator. With the Replicator, players can duplicate specific elements of the environment and seamlessly paste them onto other unique areas. Well, as long as there is a source of a bright light covering an object(s).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/a2be8073379ed1289dccbf6952bcffc335c1fcef.png[/img]

       [h3][b]HIDE AND SEEK[/b][/h3]
The Monster, lurking in the shadows of mysterious tunnels, cannot be defeated, or even wounded. Direct confrontation is impossible, so players must rely solely on hiding tactics to survive.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/0012c3388d7b0213ef680a7975c6a2e619a5d0c8.png[/img]

       [h3][b]CHECKPOINT[/b][/h3]
The game demo features a checkpoint system, so if a player is discovered and devoured by an enemy, they will not have to start the entire game from the beginning.


So, who dares to find out what’s at the end of THIS TUNNEL?

Big thanks and all the best from the Gamenastica Studios team!

notes.title: There’s something wrong with… a new upcoming horror game!
notes.notes:
After many months of work, we are thrilled to unveil the exciting details about our second game! "THERE’S SOMETHING WRONG WITH…" will be a short first-person horror experience where you navigate through dark tunnels, hide from a monstrous entity, and confront the unknown, unravelling the mysteries that lie ahead. The question is, will you be prepared to discover the truth, no matter how terrifying it may be?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/dde2cc8f82b7198dcb1ecd116306e8c9ed170ca0.png[/img]

Opposite to our first production, “The House of E.”,  the new game will not feature a traditional Inventory system. By using a special tool called the Replicator, players will be able to copy specific elements of the environment and paste them onto other unique areas.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879291/a2be8073379ed1289dccbf6952bcffc335c1fcef.png[/img]

The game will feature a save system and professional voice acting for its characters. Additionally, it will undergo localization efforts to make sure that players from different regions and language backgrounds can fully enjoy and understand the game's story, dialogue, and text.

[previewyoutube=lf7Ej3nfo48;full][/previewyoutube]

"THERE’S SOMETHING WRONG WITH…" will be available for free, as same as our previous project The House of E.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2335690/The_House_of_E/
